veniceFindings: Current preserveLastGood returns lastGood.nodes verbatim. A node that earned transitionMotion=true in the last accepted frame therefore remains transitionMotion=true inside a new interrupted frame even though frame.transitionMotionAllowed=false. That is a contradictory source contract and a plausible renderer bug.

The existing checkpoint helper fingerprints semantic contact fields, not object identity or motion flags, so the contact surface can remain exactly identical while preserved nodes are safely re-materialized with motion disabled.
The same pulseId collision question is a legitimate idempotence seam but must remain subordinate to the targeted motion-clamp repair.
